name: Box Turn (backward half)
notes: Owner's description: follows Box Turn (forward half); a backward step on the opposite (left) foot with the same quarter turn clockwise, counts 1-2-3, feet closing on 3. Step sizes and rise are assumptions the owner accepted for now (2026-11-16), the same as the forward half mirrored backwards: 0.5 back, then the right foot lands 0.4 beyond the left in the turned frame; no rise. The whole quarter turn is placed on step 2. Measured from the facing before the turn, step 2 is 0.9 back and 0.2 left. The lead goes back on step 2, so the couple turns round him (the default turning centre) and he takes the step as written while the follow travels round him. Exempt from the "partner spacing" check (2026-11-17): with the offset hold she sits to his right, so on count 2 her right foot swings round past his standing right foot, 7.6 cm from it, centre to centre. In technique this is the outside partner having to get past on a natural turn; how her step should go (a heel turn for him, the turn split between counts) is left for the figure clean-up. Remove skipChecks once it's fixed.
